subject: Confirming kickoff window and introducing security & procurement
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@averysystems.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@averysystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming kickoff window and introducing security & procurement

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — great to hear how Avery is thinking about moving ML features from experimentation to product. Per our discovery, the best next step is a 60-minute technical kickoff / demo so your engineering and security teams can validate integrations and performance expectations.

Proposed 60-minute windows (PST):
- Tue Apr 26 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Apr 27 — 14:00–15:00
- Fri Apr 29 — 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which of the above works for your team? If none work, send two alternative slots and I’ll align on our side.

I’m looping in Marissa (solutions engineer) who will run the demo and Karthik / Markus from our team for pre-demo security and procurement checks once we lock time. For planning, please share the names and emails of any internal folks who need to attend (security, infra, procurement). If possible, attach a quick network diagram or firewall checklist so we can pre-validate connectivity.

Attached: demo_agenda_v1.pdf (short agenda).

Next steps once we agree a slot:
- Confirm attendees and level of detail required (SSO, VPC routing, data retention)
- Marissa will share temporary pre-demo access instructions and a short runbook
- Karthik will list items he needs to review ahead of the call (SOC2 questions, allowed data flows)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: demo_agenda_v1.pdf]

Subject: Re: Confirming kickoff window and introducing security & procurement

Thanks Sofia — the call was helpful.

Either Wed Apr 27 14:00–15:00 PST or Fri Apr 29 09:00–10:00 PST should work for us. I’m copying Jessica (our security lead) and Elena (product) so they can confirm availability and scope.

Jessica — can you confirm if you prefer the earlier or later slot? Also, we can attach a simplified network diagram.

Samir
Director of Engineering | Avery Systems
samir.patel@averysystems.com | (650) 555-2210

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming kickoff window and introducing security & procurement

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply. Wed Apr 27 14:00–15:00 PST is confirmed on our side; I’ll send a calendar invite shortly.

Marissa, Karthik, Markus — looping you in to help scope the demo. Primary asks from Avery: SSO/SAML integration, expected latency under 1K QPS, and data retention controls for inference logs. Karthik / Markus, could you outline what you need ahead of time to make the call most effective (network ports, sample traffic, SOC2 checklist entries)? I attached a short request template (network_diagram_request.xlsx) to make the ask easier for Samir’s team.

Samir / Elena — can you confirm the attendee list and if Jessica should be on the demo? If you have the network diagram, please attach it to the thread; otherwise a slide with inbound IPs/firewall rules is sufficient.

Thanks,
Sofia

[Attachment: network_diagram_request.xlsx]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@averysystems.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@averysystems.com>, Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@averysystems.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming kickoff window and introducing security & procurement

Thanks Sofia — quick note from procurement/security perspective. For the kickoff call I’ll cover:
- High-level security architecture questions (SSO, data flow, encryption at rest/in transit)
- SLAs and escalation path (what we can commit in a POC vs production)
- Procurement checklist (contracting timeline, preferred terms)

Pre-demo asks for the Avery team (to reduce back-and-forth on the call):
1) A simple network diagram showing egress IP ranges / firewall rules (PDF/PNG is fine)
2) The role-based list of attendees (engineer, security, procurement) and their primary questions
3) Any existing compliance docs you’d like us to reference (SOC2 type II ok)

If the diagram is ready, please add it to the calendar invite or reply here. Otherwise Samir, if you can confirm you’ll share it by EOD Wed Apr 21, that gives us enough runway.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
